landing.h1: One lesson a day, from parents to kids. Free.
landing.sub: Built overnight by AI, reviewed by parents, delivered to the kids' inbox. 25 minutes, ages 8–12, free. (The product itself is in Hebrew.)
landing.follow: Get the lesson in my inbox
landing.step1b: Science, engineering, maths, space, history — something that makes a 9-year-old say "what?!"
landing.step2b: 3–4 simulations the kid drives: drag the sun, send a ship over the horizon.
landing.step3b: Four questions, an ordering task, a calculation — then "now you are the teacher": explain it back in your own words.
landing.step4b: Finishing earns a password. The kid tells it to you. What you do with it is yours.
landing.openTitle: Open source underneath, a curated feed on top
landing.pathKit: Want to run it yourself? Everything is open on GitHub — the kit, the prompts, the assistant.
landing.pathFollow: Don't want to deal with GitHub and API keys? Follow the lessons I make for my own kids.
landing.cost: The lesson is free. Always. The assistant (Arto) and the AI grading cost us real money per question — ₪10 per kid per month covers it. This is not a business: the numbers are public.
landing.shotHero: Every morning opens with one true story — no long preamble, straight to the question.
landing.shotSticks: The kid moves the stick and watches the shadow change, and that is how you measure the Earth.
landing.shotResults: At the end: a score, the day streak, and the vault that opens with today's secret password.
landing.shotArto: Arto, the assistant, answers questions inside the lesson — at eye level, and only about what is being learned.
landing.whoP1: My name is Raph and I'm a dad of four in Zikhron Yaakov. Two are already in the army, and Emma and Adam do this lesson every morning before school. What you get is exactly what they get: the same edition, the same day.
landing.whoQuote: I read every lesson before it goes out, fix it and improve it, choose the topics, and get all the feedback — write to me directly.
landing.whoMission: I believe education in Israel can change from the bottom up, one parent at a time, without waiting for the Ministry of Education.
landing.faq1a: The core is ages 8–12, grades 3–7. Every lesson has four levels, so a 2nd-grader and an 8th-grader each find a version that fits.
landing.faq2q: What if my kid is way ahead — or struggling?
landing.faq2a: You pick a level when you register: needs help, standard, on track, advanced. You can change it any time from the dashboard, and the change applies to the very next lesson. Getting it wrong at first is fine — just change it.
landing.faq3q: Do I have to do something every day?
landing.faq3a: No. The lesson arrives by email, the kid does it alone, and at the end you get the secret password. That is your whole job: hear the password. What you do with it is up to you.
landing.faq4a: No ads, no tracking, no third-party scripts on any page. Kids never register and never sign in — they open one personal link. Arto is scope-locked to the lesson: it asks no personal questions, links nowhere else, and answers off-topic questions with "that's one for your parents".
landing.faq5a: Yes, one click from the dashboard and the emails stop immediately. If you want the data deleted too, write to me and it's deleted.
landing.faq6a: Every edition stays in the library forever and can be completed whenever you like. The points count, and that day's secret password still works.
landing.faq7q: Will there be English or French?
landing.faq7a: Not yet. Hebrew first, done properly — right-to-left done right, and phrasing an Israeli kid actually understands. More languages are the first thing any surplus in the open books goes to.
landing.p1: Every morning I send my kids one lesson, built overnight by the best AI on the market today: a true story from science, engineering, maths, space or history, with a simulation they drive themselves, a short test, and a secret password at the end. 25 minutes. In Hebrew.
landing.p2: AI builds it, I read and fix it in the morning, and at eleven it goes out. My own kids do the same lesson the same day.
landing.p3: This is not a product and there is nothing to buy. The lesson is free and open, and you are welcome to follow along.
landing.demoNote: The demo is the first edition exactly as it comes out of the open kit. Entrance password: demo.
